==Description==
The '''Mummy''' was an enemy that appeared exclusively in [[Trick or Threat Town]] as part of the [[Halloween 2020 Event]]. It was faster than the [[Undead (Trick or Threat Town)|Undead]] and had more health than it.

The '''Mummy''' could be spawned by the [[Reaper (Trick or Threat Town)|Reaper]].

==Appearance==
The '''Mummy''' was wrapped around with bandages, which covered most of its body, exposing only some of its arms and its head. Its torso and legs were cobblestone white. Its neck was covered with a white neckguard. It had green skin and a surprised face. Its head was slightly tilted downwards.

==Strategy==
*A couple of [[Minigunner]]s and [[Humvee 3]]s from the [[Military Base]] can defeat the '''Mummy''' easily.
*As the '''Mummy''' can spawn in hordes, splash damage towers, such as the [[Ace Pilot]], [[Rocketeer]] or [[Mortar]], can be very helpful in defeating it.

==Trivia==
*Although it is partially covered, the shocked face on the '''Mummy''' is based on the ﾟдﾟ emoticon, popularized from 2channel.
